end.summary:
Aditya practised naming cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere in toys and objects; names were shown correctly in several examples, including sphere, cone and cuboid.
They practised choosing solids for a rocket: changed the tip from cube to cone and chose cuboid for the body; this still needs checking in new examples.
They practised identifying flat and curved faces; the cylinder’s circular flat face was identified, while the cone’s faces still need checking.
Square-versus-cube language came up during the lesson; the cuboid/cube difference was later stated using a matchbox example.
end.parentNote: Asha practised naming solid shapes in toys, building a rocket from solids, and identifying flat or curved faces. Aditya used the matchbox example to distinguish a cuboid from a cube, and changed the rocket tip from a cube to a cone; choosing shapes for a new toy and describing all cone faces still need more practice. At home, ask them to name the solids in three household objects and say which faces are flat or curved.
